verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, no OpenAPI or equivalent spec is documented, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt docs index and the open-source Python module are adjacent artifacts, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
